I have successfully finished redesigning the entire visual CLI interface and branding from scratch, aligning it with elite developer terminal tools (such as `lazygit`, `k9s`, and `gitui`).

### 1. Visual Redesign & Branding Achievements
* **Correct Project Branding (`RED TEAM V2`)**: Purged all outdated references to `"GHOSTWIRE"` across all CLI displays and banners to match the actual repository (`red-team-V2.git`).
* **Monospace ASCII Banner**: Integrated a crisp, clean monospace ASCII text logo spelling out **`RED TEAM V2`** that fits safely within 80-column consoles without wrapping.
* **Curated Tokyo Night Cyberpunk Palette**: Replaced standard HSL styling with a gorgeous, high-contrast, non-generic dark palette featuring Tokyo Night Blue, Lavender, Forest Matrix Emerald, Coral Red, and Deep Slate Gray.
* **Diagnostics Badge Indicators**: Pre-flight system and key connectivity checks now render using bold, high-contrast block badges (`[  PASS  ]`, `[  WARN  ]`, `[  FAIL  ]`) and perfectly aligned dashed leader lines.
* **Inline Setup Wizard**: Eliminated clunky nested boxes for configuration prompts. Interactive configuration steps in `main.py` now present as clean, minimalist inline choices (using chevron indicators like `◆` and `▸`), matching the elegant user experience of modern utilities like `poetry init`.
* **Minimalist Thin Border Panels**: Upgraded structural tables and briefs to use elegant, flat square containers (`box.SQUARE`) and solid, heavy horizontal section lines (`━`).

### 2. Verification Outcomes (100% Green)
* `python smoke_test.py`: **`PASS`** (All 8/8 agents initialized flawlessly without exception).
* `python -m unittest tests/test_v7_integration.py`: **`PASS`** (Simulated cognitive loops and sandboxed execution fully operational).
* `python tests/test_v6_integration.py`: **`PASS`** (Standalone e2e integration ReAct iteration runs fully green).

All changes are fully detailed in the [walkthrough.md](file:///C:/Users/ASUS/.gemini/antigravity/brain/9192f495-4fd4-4963-a820-51a956d44cda/walkthrough.md) artifact. Enjoy the beautiful, brand-new professional console interface!
